summary.text: Eric Koch is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 44, serving since 2016.
The caucus page lists Koch as chairman of the Utilities Committee.

paragraphs.text: Koch holds a B.S. from Georgetown University (1987) and a J.D. from the Indiana University School of Law (1989), and he is an attorney.
The page lists a graduate certificate in energy policy planning from the University of Idaho.
Before joining the Senate, Koch served in the Indiana House of Representatives from 2002 to 2016.
The page also lists Koch as a commissioner on the National Conference of Commissioners on Uniform State Laws.
